parameters.name: Marker
parameters.description: The marker. If the response is truncated, you can use `Marker` to obtain the content that starts from the position after the truncation point.

parameters.name: MaxItems
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return. If the response is truncated because it reaches the `MaxItems` limit, the `IsTruncated` response parameter equals `true`.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description: The type of the access policy. Valid values: `System` and `Custom`. If this parameter is not specified, all access policies are listed.
